segments.normalizedSource: ```swift MLModel.load(contentsOf: modelURL) { result in switch result { case .success(let loadedModel): print("Successfully loaded model `\(loadedModel)`.") // Use the loaded model for predictions. // ... case .failure(let error): print("Error loading model: \(error).") } } ```

```objc [MLModel loadContentsOfURL:modelURL configuration:[[MLModelConfiguration alloc] init] completionHandler:^(MLModel *loadedModel, NSError *error) { if (nil == loadedModel) { NSLog(@"Error loading model`: %@", (nil != error) ? error : modelURL); return; } NSLog(@"Successfully loaded model at: %@", modelURL); // Use the loaded model for predictions. // ... }]; ```
